title: Getting Fairness Right: Towards a Toolbox for Practitioners
findings: The paper's primary mention of religion is in citing Article 21 of the EU's Charter of Fundamental Rights, which prohibits discrimination based on grounds such as 'religion or belief'. This is presented as a legal constraint that fairness toolboxes for AI systems must consider.
